# Mono Studio

Mono Studio makes focused iPhone apps for daily practice. Each app does one useful thing, takes seconds to use and keeps personal data on the device by default. The studio does not build attention traps, advertising systems or compulsory accounts.

## Keel

See the trend.

A weight tracker without the noise. Enter one number a day and follow your seven-day average over time. No accounts, no cloud and no notifications nagging you to log. Nothing leaves your device. Keel is available on the App Store.

Page: https://monostudio.site/keel

## Fork

Stillness means in tune.

A tuner that listens to an instrument. The note settles and the screen becomes still when it is in tune. It detects guitar, bass and ukulele strings, has a chromatic mode for any note and sets the reference pitch from 430 to 450 Hz. No ads, no accounts and nothing leaves the device. Fork is available on the App Store.

Page: https://monostudio.site/fork

## Lune

Moon phases and calendar.

Explore the Moon in 3D, turn it to see the far side and pull back to see the Earth and Moon together. Drag through time to watch the phase change and check rise and set times for chosen places. A calendar keeps the Moon from each day the app is opened. Lune is in TestFlight.

Page: https://monostudio.site/lune

## Enso

One stroke, every day.

A daily practice in a single gesture. Draw one circle a day and watch the year fill in. No account, and nothing leaves your phone. Enso is in TestFlight.

Page: https://monostudio.site/enso

## Bins

Bin day, sorted.

Set a local collection schedule once and get a reminder the night before each collection. Recycling, general and garden collections are kept together. Bins is on the App Store.

Page: https://monostudio.site/bins

## Dalen

Your notes, on the Lock Screen.

One sheet for the things you need to remember. It saves as you type, can be pinned to the Lock Screen while you need it, shows on a Home Screen widget and keeps earlier versions. No account, and the sheet stays on your iPhone and works offline. Dalen is available on the App Store.

Page: https://monostudio.site/dalen

## Privacy

Mono Studio apps store data locally by default. They do not use advertising or third-party tracking. Any future account or cloud-backup feature will be optional.

Policy: https://monostudio.site/privacy

Contact: hello@monostudio.site
